data.summary:
Business Analyst with 5.2+ years of Business Analysis experience and 8.5+ years of overall experience in Investment Banking, Capital Markets, and Banking Operations. Experienced in gathering and analyzing business requirements, stakeholder management, BRD/FRD preparation, user stories, acceptance criteria, Agile Scrum, UAT, process mapping, and business process improvement.
Possess strong domain expertise in Global Payment Hub Modernization, Payment Processing (SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, Fedwire), Trade Lifecycle Management, OTC Derivatives, and Banking Operations. Proven ability to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams by translating business needs into functional requirements and ensuring successful project delivery.
Experienced in conducting workshops, requirement elicitation sessions, impact analysis, gap analysis, process modelling, UAT coordination, production support, and change management. Proficient in Jira, Confluence, SQL, API analysis, Visio, Excel, and Agile methodologies to deliver scalable business solutions aligned with organizational goals.
PROFESSIONAL HIGHLIGHTS
8.5+ Years of Overall Experience in Investment Banking & Banking Operations.
5.2+ Years of Business Analyst Experience.
Expertise in Global Payment Hub Modernization, Trade Lifecycle Dashboard, and SOP
Process Improvement.
Strong knowledge of Payment Lifecycle, SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, Fedwire, OTC Derivatives, and Trade Lifecycle Management.
Experienced in BRD, FRD, User Stories, Agile Scrum, UAT, Stakeholder Management, SQL, API
Analysis, Process Mapping, and Gap Analysis.
Strong communication, analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Experienced in working with cross-functional teams, business users, product owners,
developers, QA teams, and senior stakeholders to deliver successful business solutions.

raw_sections.experience:
Accenture Feb – 2022 to May 2025
Role: Business Analyst
Experience: 4 Months
Project – SOP Process Improvement
Client: Barclays
Domain: Payment process | Process Improvement
Project Description
The objective of this project was to standardize and optimize operational processes by reviewing existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), identifying process gaps, eliminating manual
activities, and improving operational efficiency. The project focused on enhancing workflow standardization, reducing processing time, minimizing operational risks, and improving compliance through process automation and streamlined business workflows.
Responsibilities
Gathered business requirements from business users, payment operations teams,
compliance teams, and stakeholders.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing payment processes and
future business needs.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents
(FRD).
Created detailed User Stories with Acceptance Criteria for Agile delivery.
Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for payment modernization.
Performed Gap Analysis to identify process improvements and eliminate manual activities.
Worked on the complete Payment Lifecycle, including payment initiation, validation,
authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, and confirmation.
Defined business rules for payment processing across SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire
payment networks.
Environment
Domain: Payments | Process Improvement
Methodology: Agile Scrum
Tools: Jira, Confluence, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, SQL (Basic), Postman (API Validation)
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
State Street Corporation
Role: Business Analyst
Experience: 5.2 Years
Project 1 – Global Payment Hub Modernization
Domain: Banking & Payments
Project Description
The objective of this project was to modernize the organization's payment infrastructure by replacing multiple legacy payment systems with a centralized Global Payment Hub. The solution enabled
seamless processing of domestic and international payments while supporting multiple payment rails such as SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire. The project focused on improving payment processing efficiency, reducing operational risk, ensuring regulatory compliance, and enhancing straight-through processing (STP).
Responsibilities
Gathered business requirements from business users, payment operations teams,
compliance teams, and stakeholders.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing payment processes and
future business needs.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents
(FRD).
Created detailed User Stories with Acceptance Criteria for Agile delivery.
Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for payment modernization.
Performed Gap Analysis to identify process improvements and eliminate manual activities.
Collaborated with Solution Architects and Development teams to convert business
requirements into functional solutions.
Worked on the complete Payment Lifecycle, including payment initiation, validation,
authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, and confirmation.
Defined business rules for payment processing across SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire
payment networks.
Participated in API requirement discussions for payment system integration with internal and
external applications.
Performed data mapping between legacy payment systems and the Global Payment Hub.
Worked closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure regulatory requirements were
incorporated into business requirements.
Coordinated with QA teams during SIT to validate functional requirements.
Prepared UAT test scenarios, reviewed test cases, supported business users during execution,
and obtained business sign-off.
Managed defects during SIT and UAT by coordinating with developers and business
stakeholders.
Participated in Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Sprint Review,
and Retrospective meetings.
Maintained requirement traceability throughout the Software Development Life Cycle
(SDLC).

Supported production deployment, post-production validation, and issue resolution.
Project 2 – Trade Lifecycle Dashboard
Company: State Street Corporation
Role: Business Analyst
Domain: Capital Markets | Investment Banking
Project Description
The objective of this project was to develop a centralized Trade Lifecycle Dashboard to provide end- to-end visibility of trade activities across multiple asset classes. The dashboard enabled Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, and Management teams to monitor trade status from execution through settlement by consolidating trade information from multiple upstream and downstream systems.
The solution helped improve operational efficiency by reducing manual monitoring, identifying failed trades, tracking settlement exceptions, monitoring KPIs, and providing real-time trade status across the complete trade lifecycle.
Responsibilities
Gathered business requirements from Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, Risk,
Compliance, and Business stakeholders.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing trade lifecycle
processes and reporting requirements.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents
(FRD), and Solution Documents.
Created User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and maintained Product Backlog in Jira.
Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for Trade Lifecycle reporting.
Performed Gap Analysis to identify process inefficiencies and automation opportunities.
Worked with stakeholders to define dashboard requirements, KPIs, filters, reports, and
business rules.
Collaborated with Solution Architects and Development teams to translate business
requirements into functional specifications.
Analyzed the complete Trade Lifecycle, including Trade Capture, Trade Validation, Trade
Enrichment, Allocation, Confirmation, Clearing, Settlement, and Reporting.
Worked on OTC Derivatives and Capital Market trade workflows.
Performed data mapping between source applications and dashboard reporting tables.
Defined functional requirements for trade status tracking, settlement monitoring, exception
management, and operational reporting.
Worked closely with data teams to validate trade data accuracy across multiple systems.

Supported API integration discussions for real-time trade status updates between applications.
Participated in SQL data validation to verify dashboard reports and business calculations.
Created process flow diagrams, business workflow documentation, and functional
specifications.
Coordinated with QA teams during SIT to validate functional requirements.
Prepared UAT scenarios and supported business users during User Acceptance Testing.

Logged defects, prioritized issues, and coordinated with developers until successful resolution.
Validated dashboard reports against business expectations before production deployment.
Managed change requests and analyzed business impact for new dashboard enhancements.
Conducted stakeholder walkthrough sessions and requirement review meetings.
Participated in Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective
meetings.

Supported production deployment, smoke testing, and post-production issue resolution.
Collaborated with Operations teams to ensure dashboard functionality aligned with daily
trade processing activities.
Worked closely with Project Managers and Product Owners to prioritize business
requirements and deliver project milestones on schedule.
HSBC
Role: Operations Analyst
Experience: 3.2 Years
Domain: OTC Derivatives | Trade Lifecycle Management | Investment Banking Operations
Project – OTC Derivatives Trade Lifecycle Operations
Project Description
Worked in Investment Banking Operations supporting OTC Derivatives and Trade Lifecycle processes for global financial markets. Responsible for ensuring smooth execution of post-trade operational activities including trade validation, reconciliation, settlement support, exception management, reporting, and stakeholder coordination while maintaining operational accuracy and regulatory compliance.
Responsibilities
Managed end-to-end post-trade operational activities for OTC Derivatives transactions.
Monitored the complete Trade Lifecycle from trade booking through settlement and
reporting.
Performed trade validation to ensure transaction details were accurate before downstream
processing.

Supported trade settlement activities by coordinating with internal operations teams and counterparties.

Investigated trade exceptions and worked towards timely resolution to avoid settlement failures.
Performed daily cash, trade, and position reconciliations to identify and resolve operational
breaks.
Coordinated with Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office teams for trade-related queries
and issue resolution.
Monitored settlement status and escalated critical exceptions within defined SLA timelines.

Supported collateral-related operational activities and verified transaction details whenever required.
Maintained static data and reference data accuracy for smooth trade processing.
Environment
Domain: Investment Banking | OTC Derivatives
Function: Trade Lifecycle Operations
Tools: Excel, Outlook, Internal Banking Applications

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
DOMAIN EXPERTISE
TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES
Accenture Feb – 2022 to May 2025
Role: Business Analyst
Experience:
4 Months
Project – SOP Process Improvement
Client: Barclays
Domain: Payment process | Process Improvement
Project Description
The objective of this project was to standardize and optimize operational processes by reviewing
existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), identifying process gaps, eliminating manual
activities, and improving operational efficiency. The project focused on enhancing workflow
standardization, reducing processing time, minimizing operational risks, and improving compliance
through process automation and streamlined business workflows.
Responsibilities
Gathered business requirements from business users, payment operations teams,
compliance teams, and stakeholders.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing payment processes and
future business needs.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents
(FRD).
Created detailed User Stories with Acceptance Criteria for Agile delivery.
Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for payment modernization.
Performed Gap Analysis to identify process improvements and eliminate manual activities.
Worked on the complete Payment Lifecycle, including payment initiation, validation,
authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, and confirmation.
Defined business rules for payment processing across SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire
payment networks.
Environment
Domain: Payments | Process Improvement
Methodology: Agile Scrum
Tools: Jira, Confluence, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, SQL (Basic), Postman (API Validation)
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
State Street Corporation
Role: Business Analyst
Experience:
5.2 Years
Project 1 – Global Payment Hub Modernization
Domain: Banking & Payments
Project Description
The objective of this project was to modernize the organization's payment infrastructure by replacing
multiple legacy payment systems with a centralized Global Payment Hub. The solution enabled
seamless processing of domestic and international payments while supporting multiple payment rails
such as SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire. The project focused on improving payment processing
efficiency, reducing operational risk, ensuring regulatory compliance, and enhancing straight-through
processing (STP).
Responsibilities
Gathered business requirements from business users, payment operations teams,
compliance teams, and stakeholders.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing payment processes and
future business needs.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirement Documents
(FRD).
Created detailed User Stories with Acceptance Criteria for Agile delivery.
Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for payment modernization.
Performed Gap Analysis to identify process improvements and eliminate manual activities.
Collaborated with Solution Architects and Development teams to convert business
requirements into functional solutions.
Worked on the complete Payment Lifecycle, including payment initiation, validation,
authorization, routing, clearing, settlement, and confirmation.
Defined business rules for payment processing across SWIFT, ACH, SEPA, and Fedwire
payment networks.
Participated in API requirement discussions for payment system integration with internal and
external applications.
Performed data mapping between legacy payment systems and the Global Payment Hub.
Worked closely with Compliance and Risk teams to ensure regulatory requirements were
incorporated into business requirements.
Coordinated with QA teams during SIT to validate functional requirements.
Prepared UAT test scenarios, reviewed test cases, supported business users during execution,
and obtained business sign-off.
Managed defects during SIT and UAT by coordinating with developers and business
stakeholders.
Participated in Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-up, Sprint Review,
and Retrospective meetings.
Maintained requirement traceability throughout the Software Development Life Cycle
(SDLC).
Supported production deployment, post-production validation, and issue resolution.
Project 2 – Trade Lifecycle Dashboard
Company: State Street Corporation
Role: Business Analyst
Domain: Capital Markets | Investment Banking
Project Description
The objective of this project was to develop a centralized Trade Lifecycle Dashboard to provide end-
to-end visibility of trade activities across multiple asset classes. The dashboard enabled Front Office,
Middle Office, Operations, and Management teams to monitor trade status from execution through
settlement by consolidating trade information from multiple upstream and downstream systems.
The solution helped improve operational efficiency by reducing manual monitoring, identifying failed
trades, tracking settlement exceptions, monitoring KPIs, and providing real-time trade status across
the complete trade lifecycle.
Responsibilities
Gathered business requirements from Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, Risk,
Compliance, and Business stakeholders.
Conducted requirement elicitation workshops to understand existing trade lifecycle
processes and reporting requirements.
Prepared Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents
(FRD), and Solution Documents.
Created User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and maintained Product Backlog in Jira.
Documented AS-IS and TO-BE business process flows for Trade Lifecycle reporting.
Performed Gap Analysis to identify process inefficiencies and automation opportunities.
Worked with stakeholders to define dashboard requirements, KPIs, filters, reports, and
business rules.
Collaborated with Solution Architects and Development teams to translate business
requirements into functional specifications.
Analyzed the complete Trade Lifecycle, including Trade Capture, Trade Validation, Trade
Enrichment, Allocation, Confirmation, Clearing, Settlement, and Reporting.
Worked on OTC Derivatives and Capital Market trade workflows.
Performed data mapping between source applications and dashboard reporting tables.
Defined functional requirements for trade status tracking, settlement monitoring, exception
management, and operational reporting.
Worked closely with data teams to validate trade data accuracy across multiple systems.
Supported API integration discussions for real-time trade status updates between
applications.
Participated in SQL data validation to verify dashboard reports and business calculations.
Created process flow diagrams, business workflow documentation, and functional
specifications.
Coordinated with QA teams during SIT to validate functional requirements.
Prepared UAT scenarios and supported business users during User Acceptance Testing.
Logged defects, prioritized issues, and coordinated with developers until successful
resolution.
Validated dashboard reports against business expectations before production deployment.
Managed change requests and analyzed business impact for new dashboard enhancements.
Conducted stakeholder walkthrough sessions and requirement review meetings.
Participated in Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospective
meetings.
Supported production deployment, smoke testing, and post-production issue resolution.
Collaborated with Operations teams to ensure dashboard functionality aligned with daily
trade processing activities.
Worked closely with Project Managers and Product Owners to prioritize business
requirements and deliver project milestones on schedule.
HSBC
Role: Operations Analyst
Experience:
3.2 Years
Domain: OTC Derivatives | Trade Lifecycle Management | Investment Banking Operations
Project – OTC Derivatives Trade Lifecycle Operations
Project Description
Worked in Investment Banking Operations supporting OTC Derivatives and Trade Lifecycle processes
for global financial markets. Responsible for ensuring smooth execution of post-trade operational
activities including trade validation, reconciliation, settlement support, exception management,
reporting, and stakeholder coordination while maintaining operational accuracy and regulatory
compliance.
Responsibilities
Managed end-to-end post-trade operational activities for OTC Derivatives transactions.
Monitored the complete Trade Lifecycle from trade booking through settlement and
reporting.
Performed trade validation to ensure transaction details were accurate before downstream
processing.
Supported trade settlement activities by coordinating with internal operations teams and
counterparties.
Investigated trade exceptions and worked towards timely resolution to avoid settlement
failures.
Performed daily cash, trade, and position reconciliations to identify and resolve operational
breaks.
Coordinated with Front Office, Middle Office, and Back Office teams for trade-related queries
and issue resolution.
Monitored settlement status and escalated critical exceptions within defined SLA timelines.
Supported collateral-related operational activities and verified transaction details whenever
required.
Maintained static data and reference data accuracy for smooth trade processing.
Environment
Domain: Investment Banking | OTC Derivatives
Function: Trade Lifecycle Operations
Tools: Excel, Outlook, Internal Banking Applications
